profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Graduate from NJIT with a B.S in Computer Science, currently I am a Software Engineer at BNY Mellon primarily working on our backend services, I have over 2 year of experience working with Java, Spring boot, and in the backend space.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.description:
•Collaborated with the Liquidity Service Team to perform health checks to each of their microservices using Spring Boot and Maven.
•Developed a core microservice that accepts a request from a wrapper and process it in the Oracle Database and generates a feed.
•Designed REST APIs for the Emailer and Health Check microservices.
•Conducted weekly progress and check-in meetings with fellow colleagues under the Liquidity Service Team.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Optimized the pupil information reading algorithm to process images of pixels faster.
•Unit testing and debugging issues from project every scrum phase.
•Led a software development team to complete an iPhone that is a Swift based application, mediated between the development team and sponsors.
•Conducted scrum weekly meetings and scrum reports, outlining progress made.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Manufactured image inspector submission tools utilized by vendors for the Bed Bath & Beyond website. 
•Communicated effectively with vendors to validate the images to meet all the expectations.

positions.title: Lead Instructor
positions.description: •Guided students in acquiring foundational education from the basic math level to advanced Calculus.

projects.title: MoreToDos- React, MongoDB, Express, Node.JS
projects.description: A web application for users to create and connect with people to share their to-do lists.

projects.title: Weather Application- Angular, TypeScript, HTML
projects.description: A single page application that can update dynamically showing weather of a given city and country.
